title: Prelude
subtitle: A pause, then the rhythm finds its way back
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, sinus rhythm with overdrive suppression and optional respiratory sinus arrhythmia; releasing atrial pacing produces a long first return followed by a warm-up.
tryThis: Hold a tempo for a little while, then let go and listen for the return.

title: Echo
subtitle: An arpeggio folds into a chord
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, dual AV-nodal pathways: a premature atrial beat blocks in the fast pathway, conducts slowly down the slow one, and may return up the fast one.
tryThis: Tap one early beat and listen for the sound that comes back.

title: Meter
subtitle: Beats fall into groups
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, progressive nodal decrement produces Wenckebach periodicity as the drive cycle shortens; an infranodal mode drops beats without prolongation.
tryThis: Hold a tempo and quicken it slowly until a beat goes missing.

title: Ostinato
subtitle: A fast figure and its slower shadow
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, a macroreentrant atrial ring filtered by a nodal chain gives variable conduction to the ventricle; entrainment and isthmus ablation are available gestures.
tryThis: Draw a line across the ring and watch the figure slow, then stop.

title: Retrograde
subtitle: A melody, then the same melody backwards
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, an accessory pathway supports orthodromic and antidromic circulation, which visit the shared sites in opposite orders.
tryThis: Start a circuit with an early tap, then try one from the other side.

title: Ghost
subtitle: One voice goes quiet and stays quiet
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, concealed retrograde penetration keeps one bundle refractory under steady pacing, so it stays silent until a longer interval releases it.
tryThis: Hold a tempo, then leave out one beat and listen for the voice to return.

title: Canon
subtitle: One melody, two voices, half a lap apart
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, a single circulating wave is joined by a second wave in the excitable gap, and entry slowing settles their spacing at half a lap.
tryThis: Add one well-timed tap and watch the second voice find its place.

title: Hemiola
subtitle: Two tempos learn to line up
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, modulated parasystole: electrotonic coupling lets one automatic focus shift another, which can phase-lock the two at ratios such as 3:2 and 4:3.
tryThis: Turn up Listen to each other slowly and notice when the two voices settle.

title: Unknown
subtitle: A hidden rhythm to work out
epMechanism: In this lumped-element model, a generated hidden substrate that you probe with pacing and taps; the consequences emerge from the same engine as every other study.
tryThis: Tap and listen, then say what you think is hidden.
